scientific_integrity: Analytic proof supplied; finite exact arithmetic and complete reproducible enumeration up to 12 nodes are supplemental checks, not infinite certificates.
scientific_limitations: Exact formulas assume uniform plane trees and positive integer depths. Scaling limit is pointwise for h/sqrt(n) to fixed t>0. Historical priority versus general multivariate enumeration has not been independently established.
title: A sharp depth crossover for root branching in uniform plane trees
